objective: Verify fresh-session project recovery in Codex and Claude Code from saved files rather than model memory.
scenario: Each host creates a synthetic project handoff, ends the session, and starts a new session using only the saved project files and status record.
expected_behaviors: The host restores the correct current stage, decisions, evidence references, assumptions, blockers and next action.
Missing information is labelled rather than guessed.
The host does not claim access to an earlier chat that is unavailable.
prohibited_behaviors: Rely only on hidden model memory or previous chat text.
Invent absent decisions or completed tests.
